主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, which is a report to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing is for the month of January 2012 and includes information about the issuance of various types of securities, including JUMP Securities, Reverse Convertible Notes, and Fixed to Floating Rate Notes. The document also includes opinions from legal counsel regarding the validity of these securities under Canadian, Ontario, and New York law. The filing is related to the Bank’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). The securities mentioned include those linked to the iShares® MSCI Emerging Markets Index Fund and the Common Stock of Apple Inc. The filing is dated January 30, 2012, and includes details about the pricing, settlement, and principal amounts of the issued securities.
